exceptions.scope: optional deno-host probe through deno_core; not the production v8-host path
exceptions.risk: No known vulnerability is reported. Oryn does not deserialize untrusted bincode data through this dependency.
exceptions.resolution: Remove the deno-host comparison probe or migrate when deno_core no longer depends on bincode 1.x.

exceptions.scope: build-time transitive dependency of the pinned v8 and v8x crates
exceptions.risk: No known vulnerability is reported and the crate is not exposed to page-controlled runtime input.
exceptions.resolution: Replace through the next qualified V8/V8X release that removes paste.

exceptions.scope: transitive rand dependency in the Oryn1 Chromium compatibility dependency graph
exceptions.risk: Cargo reports no RustSec vulnerability. Native Oryn secret handles use operating-system randomness through getrandom directly.
exceptions.resolution: Advance the frozen compatibility dependency only for a security-compatible upstream release that removes the yanked version.

exceptions.scope: transitive dependency of optional oryn-render through fontdue; it parses only Oryn's checksum-pinned embedded Noto Sans asset
exceptions.risk: No vulnerability is reported. Page-supplied font bytes are not passed to fontdue or ttf-parser, and the package is absent from the native core and default parent dependency graphs.
exceptions.resolution: Replace fontdue with a maintained skrifa-based raster path or a maintained upstream rasterizer before the review deadline.
